description: The telematics application shall provide a user login screen with username/password and biometric authentication options.
The telematics application shall support role-based access control (Admin, Fleet Manager, Driver, Viewer).
The telematics application shall integrate with OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect for single sign-on (SSO).
The telematics application shall enforce password complexity rules (min 8 chars, uppercase, lowercase, digit, special char).
The telematics application shall lock the user account after 5 consecutive failed login attempts for 15 minutes.
The telematics application shall support multi-factor authentication (MFA) via SMS or authenticator app.
The telematics application shall automatically log out idle sessions after a configurable timeout (default: 30 minutes).
The telematics application shall display a real-time map view showing all connected vehicles with live position updates.
The telematics application shall support map layers including satellite, terrain, and traffic overlays.
The telematics application shall allow users to click on a vehicle marker to view detailed vehicle status information.
The telematics application shall update vehicle positions on the map at a minimum refresh rate of 5 seconds.
The telematics application shall support vehicle clustering on the map when zoom level shows overlapping markers.
The telematics application shall display vehicle heading direction on map markers.
The telematics application shall allow users to filter displayed vehicles by group, status, or custom tags.
The telematics application shall support historical route playback with adjustable playback speed (1x to 20x).
The telematics application shall display a fleet dashboard with summary KPIs (total vehicles, active, idle, offline).
The telematics application shall display average fleet fuel consumption on the dashboard.
The telematics application shall display total fleet distance traveled (daily, weekly, monthly) on the dashboard.
The telematics application shall display a driver behavior score summary (fleet average and per-driver) on the dashboard.
The telematics application dashboard shall support configurable widgets that users can add, remove, and rearrange.
The telematics application shall display real-time alert count and severity breakdown on the dashboard.
The telematics application shall allow users to create geofences by drawing circular or polygonal regions on the map.
The telematics application shall allow users to name, categorize, and assign colors to geofences.
The telematics application shall generate alerts when a vehicle enters or exits a configured geofence.
The telematics application shall support geofence scheduling (active only during specified time windows).
The telematics application shall support importing geofences from KML/GeoJSON files.
The telematics application shall support exporting geofence definitions to KML/GeoJSON format.
The telematics application shall display a geofence violation history report filterable by vehicle, geofence, and date range.
The telematics application shall support speed limit alerts configurable per geofence or road segment.
The telematics application shall generate an over-speed alert when vehicle exceeds the configured speed threshold.
The telematics application shall log all speed violations with timestamp, location, speed, and limit.
The telematics application shall provide a notification center displaying all alerts sorted by time and severity.
The telematics application shall support alert delivery via in-app notification, email, and SMS.
The telematics application shall support configurable alert rules (trigger conditions, recipients, channels).
The telematics application shall support alert escalation if not acknowledged within a configurable time period.
The telematics application shall support alert suppression rules to prevent notification flooding.
The telematics application shall allow users to acknowledge, snooze, or dismiss alerts.
The telematics application shall categorize alerts by type: geofence, speed, maintenance, driver behavior, system.
The telematics application shall provide a trip history view showing all trips per vehicle with start/end time and distance.
The telematics application shall display trip route on the map with color-coded speed segments.
The telematics application shall calculate and display trip duration, average speed, max speed, and fuel consumed per trip.
The telematics application shall allow users to export trip reports as CSV or PDF.
The telematics application shall support trip detection based on ignition ON/OFF events.
The telematics application shall detect and flag stop events within trips (duration, location).
The telematics application shall support merging short trips separated by brief stops into a single trip.
The telematics application shall display a driver scorecard based on harsh braking, acceleration, cornering, and speeding events.
The telematics application shall rank drivers by behavior score within a fleet or group.
The telematics application shall display driver behavior trends over configurable time periods (week, month, quarter).
The telematics application shall generate automatic coaching recommendations based on driver behavior patterns.
The telematics application shall allow fleet managers to set driver behavior score thresholds for alerts.
The telematics application shall support driver identification via Bluetooth driver ID tags or login-based assignment.
The telematics application shall detect and report distracted driving events (e.g., phone usage via accelerometer patterns).
The telematics application shall detect and report fatigue driving events based on driving duration and time of day.
The telematics application shall display vehicle health status including DTC codes with descriptions.
The telematics application shall provide predictive maintenance alerts based on mileage, engine hours, and DTC history.
The telematics application shall track and display maintenance schedules per vehicle (oil change, tire rotation, inspection).
The telematics application shall send maintenance due reminders to fleet managers and assigned drivers.
The telematics application shall allow users to log completed maintenance activities with date, type, cost, and notes.
The telematics application shall display battery health status and generate low-battery alerts.
The telematics application shall provide a maintenance cost tracking report per vehicle and fleet-wide.
The telematics application shall generate fleet utilization reports (usage rate, idle time, distance per vehicle).
The telematics application shall generate fuel consumption reports with trend analysis.
The telematics application shall generate driver behavior summary reports with configurable date ranges.
The telematics application shall generate geofence compliance reports.
The telematics application shall support scheduled automatic report generation and email delivery.
The telematics application shall support report export in CSV, PDF, and Excel formats.
The telematics application shall provide interactive charts (bar, line, pie) within all report views.
The telematics application shall support custom report builder allowing users to select data fields and filters.
The telematics application shall support report templates that can be saved and reused.
The telematics application shall allow fleet managers to send remote door lock/unlock commands to vehicles.
The telematics application shall allow authorized users to send remote engine immobilization commands.
The telematics application shall display real-time command execution status (pending, sent, acknowledged, executed, failed).
The telematics application shall require confirmation dialog before executing critical remote commands.
The telematics application shall log all remote commands with user, timestamp, vehicle, command type, and result.
The telematics application shall restrict remote command access based on user role and permissions.
The telematics application shall support vehicle grouping and hierarchical fleet organization.
The telematics application shall allow bulk operations (assign geofence, update settings) on vehicle groups.
The telematics application shall provide a vehicle inventory view with details (VIN, model, year, SIM, firmware version).
The telematics application shall support vehicle onboarding workflow with step-by-step provisioning.
The telematics application shall support vehicle decommissioning with data archival option.
The telematics application shall display firmware version per vehicle and support OTA update initiation from the UI.
The telematics application shall display OTA update progress and history per vehicle.
The telematics application shall provide a responsive web design supporting desktop (1920x1080) and tablet (1024x768) resolutions.
The telematics application shall support modern browsers: Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari (latest 2 versions).
The telematics application shall provide a native mobile app (iOS and Android) with core tracking and alert features.
The telematics application shall support push notifications on mobile devices for critical alerts.
The telematics application shall load the dashboard within 3 seconds on a standard broadband connection.
The telematics application shall support dark mode and light mode themes.
The telematics application shall support localization for at least English, German, and Japanese languages.
The telematics application backend shall expose a RESTful API for third-party integrations.
The telematics application API shall use API key and OAuth 2.0 token-based authentication.
The telematics application API shall support rate limiting (configurable requests per minute per client).
The telematics application shall provide webhook support for event-driven integrations.
The telematics application API shall include versioning (e.g., /api/v1/) for backward compatibility.
The telematics application shall provide Swagger/OpenAPI documentation for all API endpoints.
The telematics application shall support integration with ERP systems for maintenance cost and fuel card data.
The telematics application shall support integration with insurance telematics platforms for UBI data sharing.
The telematics application shall encrypt all data at rest using AES-256 encryption.
The telematics application shall enforce HTTPS (TLS 1.2+) for all client-server communications.
The telematics application shall maintain a complete audit trail of user actions (login, commands, config changes).
The telematics application shall comply with GDPR data privacy requirements including data export and deletion requests.
The telematics application shall implement CSRF, XSS, and SQL injection protection measures.
The telematics application shall support data retention policies with configurable auto-purge for aged telemetry data.
The telematics application backend shall support horizontal scaling to handle up to 100,000 connected vehicles.
The telematics application shall maintain 99.9% uptime SLA for core tracking and alerting services.
The telematics application shall support database read replicas for high-availability reporting queries.
The telematics application shall implement message queuing (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ) for asynchronous telemetry processing.
The telematics application shall support containerized deployment via Docker and Kubernetes.
The telematics application shall implement health check endpoints for all microservices.
The telematics application shall support automated CI/CD pipelines for build, test, and deployment.
The telematics application shall support blue-green or canary deployment strategies for zero-downtime releases.
